concerns.text: FR-007 (configurable hard stop for time/sample limit) lacks a complete task. T011a and T011b are marked unimplemented. Without these, the system cannot enforce the runtime/sample constraints mandated by the spec and plan.

FR-009 (assertion density) and SC-006 are not covered by a primary implementation task in Phase 4. T029b is unimplemented, and the logic is deferred to T055 in 'Phase R'. The core US2 flow cannot calculate this metric without T029b.

US-2 Acceptance Scenario 3 (handle failed compilation with [deferred] coverage) is not covered. T028a and T028b are unimplemented. The pipeline cannot gracefully handle compilation failures as required by the spec.

Plan 'Strict Pairing Unit' logic (exclude samples without isolated manual baseline) is deferred to T051 in 'Phase R'. This logic is required in the core data loading/analysis flow (T006/T009) before any results are generated, not as a post-hoc revision.

Plan 'Data Sourcing Fix' (streaming download, chunked processing) is deferred to T050 in 'Phase R'. The core data loading task T006 assumes a local parquet file, contradicting the plan's requirement for streaming and robust error handling.

FR-001 (prompt formatting) edge case handling for ambiguous inputs is incomplete. T018 (retry logic for short prompts) is unimplemented, leaving the prompt generation pipeline vulnerable to the edge cases defined in the spec.

SC-005 (rate of syntactically valid generation) measurement is incomplete. T018b (logging default template usage/metrics) is unimplemented, and the 'default template' strategy is not defined in the spec, creating a gap in measuring the success rate.
